notes: A225563_no_partition (A225563_mathlib.lean): for n >= 1 and k >= 3 the totient trajectory traj n (n, phi n, ..., 1, as a list) has no partition into k parts of equal sum (parts = lists whose concatenation is a permutation of traj n); A225563_conjecture is the odd-k case. Route: 2 phi(x) <= x for even x, phi(x) even for x >= 3, so the trajectory sum is at most 3n - 3 < 3n while the part containing n forces k*s >= 3n. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: none. The list reading of 'partitioned into sets' is the only interpretive step; certificate/bound.py cross-checks the sum bound to 10^6.
